# mkt

> Multi-platform marketing CLI in Rust: manage ads, ad sets, audiences,
> organic posts, and analytics across Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads,
> TikTok, and LinkedIn from one terminal. Built agent-first: stable JSON
> output on stdout, structured JSON errors on stderr, documented exit codes
> (0-7), --dry-run on every mutating command, fully non-interactive.

Command shape: `mkt [global flags] <provider> <domain> <action> [flags]`.
Install: `cargo install mkt-cli` (binary `mkt`) or prebuilt binaries from
GitHub Releases. Start with `mkt --help` (includes the exit-code table) and
`mkt doctor` (validates credentials without printing them). Credentials via
`MKT_*` environment variables or `~/.config/mkt/config.toml` profiles.
Safety contract: campaigns, ad sets, and boosted posts are always created
PAUSED; activating delivery is an explicit separate step. Transient API
failures retry automatically with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After.
An MCP server (`mkt mcp serve`) exposes the same operations to chat agents
without a terminal (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT).
